description: A7 replay: the payer of KIK-1017 sends the same 'never arrived' email twice as two separate tickets, but the carrier shows the $56.00 clutch bag delivered. Expected step-up SHIPMENT_DELIVERED on each: the mandate asks the merchant first, with the delivery record on the card, so the merchant sees the same claim twice. The message is simulated. Illustrative people and orders.
